title: SEC annual parser request (sec-annual-v2)
description: What platform-core writes on the parser's stdin (internal/research/analyze.go). Go is the producer and Python's financials.py the consumer. Our own fields are closed and typed; submissions and companyfacts are the stored SEC originals, kept byte for byte, so only the identity fields the parser checks are typed and SEC's other fields are passed through.

as_of.description: Go's asOfText: UTC with exactly six fraction digits and Z.

submissions.description: SEC submissions original (data.sec.gov/submissions). Extra SEC fields are ignored by this contract.

name.description: Bounded only by the 16 MiB source limit.

tickers.description: Bounded only by the 16 MiB source limit; the requested symbol must be listed (checked at run time).

companyfacts.description: SEC companyfacts original (data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts). Extra SEC fields are ignored by this contract.

sec_cik.description: A CIK as either SEC original may write it, as Go's secCIK and Python's parse_cik both accept: a positive integer, or a string of 1 to 10 digits that is not zero. That it names the requested issuer is checked at run time, not by this schema.
